summary: Climber fell from ledge on Sharksfin south of Estes Park, severely injuring ankle; multi-agency helicopter evacuation.
responding_agency: NPS, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Larimer County SAR, Army Black Hawk
notes: Collegian 2017-08-22: Shark's Fin of The Crags, RMNP; 49-yo Boulder climber, broken leg; friend's 11:55 a.m. call to Larimer County Sheriff; RMNP rescuers + Larimer County SAR + Rocky Mountain Rescue; Blackhawk hoist ~4 p.m.; flown to Estes Park Fair Grounds, ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center; scene cleared ~8:30 p.m. DATE NOTE: Collegian text says "Monday" (= 2017-08-21) but the row's 2017-08-20 (Sunday) comes from the AAC article and the article's rescue photo is timestamped 2017-08-20 18:17 — date kept as 2017-08-20 pending curation pass.
